tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return authenticated platform identity, service metadata, and database connection status.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Intelligently search K53 Co-Pilot candidates, common mistakes, DLTC testing centers, and database schemas with live matches.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against the K53 Co-Pilot Cloudflare D1 database (SELECT or PRAGMA only) with execution timing and column metadata.

tools.name: get_candidate_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve a deep diagnostic dossier for a learner candidate by ID, email, or name. Returns statutory DLTC readiness, triple-hurdle breakdown (Rules, Signs, Controls), test history trajectory, top 5 recurring mistakes, and coaching recommendations.

tools.name: get_candidate_summary
tools.description: Alias for get_candidate_dossier. Look up a learner candidate to inspect readiness, scores, test trajectory, and weaknesses.

tools.name: get_top_mistakes
tools.description: Retrieve South Africa's most failed K53 test questions across all learners, segmented by statutory section (Rules of the Road, Road Signs, Vehicle Controls) with error frequencies, candidate counts, and mastery recovery rates.

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive executive telemetry, candidate audience composition, test volume velocity, and real-world DLTC pass rate efficacy.

tools.name: get_outcomes_summary
tools.description: Retrieve real-world official traffic department (DLTC) driving license exam outcomes (pass rate vs 44% national baseline, failure hurdle deficits, and center performance rankings).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_candidate_dossier · Private data: whoami, search, execute_sql · Public sink: get_candidate_dossier · Destructive: execute_sql.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_candidate_dossier · Private data: whoami, search, execute_sql · Public sink: get_candidate_dossier · Destructive: execute_sql

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
